chapter.verse: Pasian tungah a gingin ka kiko hi, amah in kei hong zak theih nadingin Pasian tungah a gingin ka kiko hi.
Ka lungkham hunin keimah in Topa zongin; zanin thungenin gim het loin ka khut ka zan a, ahi zongin hehnepna ka ngah kei hi.
Keimah in Pasian ka ngaihsun a, ka tau hi; lung ka geelgeel a, ka gim mahmah hi.
Nangmah in ihmu lo dingin nong bawl a, lungkham-in ka pau thei kei hi.
Hunluite ka ngaihsun a, sawt pek lai-a kumte ka phawk hi.
Zan-in ka lungsim tawh ka kiho a, lung geelgeelin thu ka kan ciangin:
“ Topa in hong nial paisuakin, maipha hong pia kik ngei lo ding ahi hiam?
Ama itna kip bei paisuak ding ahi hiam? Ama thuciamte a bei paisuak ding ahi hiam?
Pasian in hehpihna a neih ding mangngilh khin ta ahi hiam? Amah in hehna tawh ama hehpihnate humcip khin ahi hiam?” ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin ahih leh, “Sang Penpa khut taklam a kikhelna in keima kha-kham veina ahi hi,” ka ci hi.
Topa ’ sepnate ka lungsimah ka phawk ding hi; hi hi, hunlui lai-a nangma nalamdangte ka ciamteh ding hi.
Nangma nasepna khempeuh ka lungngaingai ding a, nangma sepna a liante ka ngaihsunsun ding hi.
Pasian aw, nangma lampi, siangtho hi. Eima Pasian tawh kibangin bang pasian lian ahi hiam?
Nangmah in nalamdangte a bawl, mite lakah nangma vangliatna a langkhiasak khin Pasian na hi hi.
Nangmah in na khut tawh Jakob leh Josef’ tate, na mite na tankhia hi.
Tuite in nang hong muh ciang, Pasian aw, tuite in nang hong muh ciangin, amaute lau uh hi, hi taktak hi, tuithukpi zong a liing hi.
Meiipite in tui sungkhia-in, vante ging damdam a, nangma thaltangte mun citeng-ah leeng uh hi.
Na vanging lianpi pingpei sungah om-in, khuaphialepte in leitung taan’ a, leitang liingin kising hi.
Nangma lamlian in tuipi tung hi a, nangma lamneu in tui liante tung ahi hi; ahi zongin na khekhapte kimu lo hi.
Nangmah in, Moses leh Aaron’ khut tawh, na mite, tuuhon bangin na makaih hi.
